title: Fix 283
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement says cases check validates a retired case's fledge-task binding; the code checked it before its retired-case early return. Leif decided the check is skipped for retired cases so the original binding stays as history; a retired case was already never run (find_checked), so only the check order, a test and the docs change.
acceptance_criteria: chough cases check passes a retired case whose fledge-task binding names a task no longer in fledge.toml, with the binding kept as written, while an active case naming a missing task is still refused naming the task; cases run still refuses the retired case.

answers.constraints: Leif's decision on #283 (2026-11-18 planning interview): skip the check for retired cases, returning early before the fledge-task binding check, so the original binding stays as history. Human gates as plain text in tasks.md. No other lesson or principle constrains it.
